## 1. Random variables

Define the quantity being recorded. Distinguish discrete values from continuous measurements.

Connect frequency tables, histograms and polygons. Use cumulative frequency to locate the median.

Explore how class width changes a graph, then use repeated trials to estimate probabilities.
